messages:
eli: Heads-up — planning a DevPulse refapp + 9-min micro-tutorial for Wed. Targets: 150 visits, 60 GH clones, 45 RSVPs. Need owners: blog post, one-slide bench, RSVP flow, hero copy A/B, inbound routing. Who picks which?

mona: Ill take the blog + HN blurb. Will draft two angles: quickstart walkthrough and bench-led story.

tess: I can own RSVP + TY email. Will capture name/email/company_size/job_title/use_case and add utm_source=devpulse, utm_campaign=devpulse-launch. Zapier -> CRM mapping okay?

eli: Perfect. For inbound routing: if company_size>100 or job_title contains "platform|infra" -> AE queue, tag `lead:devpulse-hot`. Else -> SDR nurture with `lead:devpulse` tag.

mona: Copy variants: technical, outcome, and friendly. Ill label them copy/v1, copy/v2, copy/v3 and push to the ticket. A/B run for 48h, KPI CTR->RSVP >= 2.5%.

tess: RSVP flow note: include optional `use_case` free-text and a quick checkbox for "interested in dedicated capacity". If checked, auto-tag `interest:dedicated` and route to AE.

eli: bench ask: one-slide showing p50/p95 latency + $/1k tokens comparing hosted vs dedicated. Please add a 1-line methods note: 512 tokens, batch=4.

mona: will sync with eng for a short quote to include in blog.

ops-bot: Created ticket MK-7201: "DevPulse refapp launch checklist" assigned to eli, mona, tess. Reminder set 48h before launch.

tess: Confirmed. Ill share Zap blueprint and thank-you email copy in MK-7201.

eli: Ill prepare the demo script (9-min) — show setup (60s), long-context demo (90s), then bench slide + 30s wrap.

mona: Ill upload blog drafts and the three hero images.

eli: Quick decision: run hero A/B on site only for 48h then push winner to social. Agree?

tess: Agreed. Also will include 1-click calendar add in the thank-you email.

mona: Confirmed. Scheduling a 20m prep for Mon 10:00 PT to review slide + RSVP flow. If anyone sees blockers post here. :rocket:
